fields.v: Spec-first (a specification on the GitHub Spec Kit template is written before the code and given to the agent as its task; it is used for that task only and not kept or maintained afterwards). Authors' wording: 'task specification', 'structure derived from the GitHub Spec Kit template'
fields.quote: Each spec variation is constructed from the task’s original SWE-bench problem statement, with structure derived from the GitHub Spec Kit template [9].
fields.why: A Spec Kit-structured specification written before implementation and handed to the agent as its task fits Böckeler's spec-first level, even though the authors do not name an SDD level.
fields.doubt: A especificação (modelo Spec Kit) é escrita antes do código e entregue ao agente como tarefa, o que corresponde a 'spec-first' de Böckeler, embora o autor não use esse termo. Lê §3.1 (pág. 3) e decide entre 'spec-first' e 'Not classifiable'.
